cities.name: Mumbai
cities.tagline: The City of Dreams & Coastal Alleys
cities.description: From colonial art deco promenades to bustling street kebab lanes and fishing villages.

cities.name: Pune
cities.description: Heritage Wada architecture, student cafe culture, and Western Ghats foothill trails.

cities.name: Jaipur
cities.tagline: The Historic Pink City of Crafts & Havelis
cities.description: Royal palaces, 5th-generation hand block printing, and centuries-old sweet houses.

cities.name: Udaipur
cities.tagline: The City of Lakes & Royal Courtyards
cities.description: Tranquil lake boat rides, miniature painting ateliers, and sunset rooftop ghats.

cities.name: Goa
cities.description: Portuguese heritage villas, hidden river islands, artisanal feni tasting, and sunset beaches.

cities.name: Kochi
cities.tagline: Queen of the Arabian Sea & Spice Route
cities.description: Chinese fishing nets, historic Jew Town spice warehouses, Kathakali and backwater canoe trails.

cities.name: Delhi
cities.tagline: The Imperial Capital of Empires & Chaat
cities.description: Mughal walled city alleys, Sufi qawwalis, Lodhi garden art walks, and legendary food trails.

cities.name: Bengaluru
cities.tagline: The Garden City of Microbreweries & Filter Coffee
cities.description: Heritage tiffin rooms, tree-lined botanical parks, indie music circles, and silk markets.

cities.name: Varanasi
cities.tagline: The Eternal Spiritual City on the Holy Ganges
cities.description: Sunrise boat rituals along 84 ghats, evening Ganga Aarti, Banarasi silk looms, and malaiyo sweets.

cities.name: Lucknow
cities.tagline: The City of Nawabs, Chikankari & Kebabs
cities.description: Melting Galouti kebabs, ornate Imambaras, exquisite shadow-work embroidery, and Urdu poetry.

cities.name: Rishikesh
cities.tagline: The Yoga Capital & Himalayan River Valley
cities.description: Ganga whitewater rafting, cliff-side organic cafes, sound healing, and pine forest trails.

cities.name: Kolkata
cities.tagline: The Cultural Capital of Art, Tramways & Sweets
cities.description: Clay idol potters of Kumartuli, vintage College Street book bazaars, kathi rolls, and mishti doi.

cities.name: Darjeeling
cities.tagline: Queen of the Hills & Champagne of Teas
cities.description: Heritage steam toy train, morning views of Mt. Kanchenjunga, and organic tea estate plucking.

cities.name: Shillong
cities.tagline: The Scotland of the East & Living Root Bridges
cities.description: Pristine canyon viewpoints, Khasi indigenous bamboo crafts, indie rock cafes, and waterfalls.

cities.name: Amritsar
cities.tagline: The Golden City of Devotion & Legendary Kulchas
cities.description: Harmandir Sahib Golden Temple langar, crispy butter-soaked kulchas, and Phulkari embroidery.

providers.description: Verified network of master craftspersons, traditional culinary custodians, and licensed heritage storytellers across India.

experiences.title: Ranwar Village Indo-Portuguese Heritage Walk & Irani Chai
experiences.description: Stroll through quiet 18th-century East Indian heritage lanes, vintage Catholic grottoes, street murals, and enjoy bun maska with Irani chai.
experiences.address: Ranwar Village, Bandra West, Mumbai

experiences.title: Aaswad Traditional Maharashtrian Thalipeeth & Kothimbir Vadi Tasting
experiences.description: Relish award-winning authentic Maharashtrian delicacies: crispy multigrain thalipeeth, steamed kothimbir vadi, and fresh piyush drink.
experiences.address: Opposite Shiv Sena Bhavan, Dadar West, Mumbai

experiences.title: Kala Ghoda Art Deco Walk & Contemporary Pottery Studio
experiences.description: Discover Victorian Gothic and Art Deco buildings followed by a hands-on wheel throwing session with an independent ceramic artist.
experiences.address: Kala Ghoda Arts Precinct, Fort, Mumbai

experiences.title: Sassoon Docks Morning Fisherman Action & Secret Sunset Pier
experiences.description: Experience Mumbai's oldest wet docks in action at dawn as Koli fisherfolk auction fresh catches, followed by a serene walk on the pier.
experiences.address: Sassoon Docks, Colaba, Mumbai

experiences.title: Parsi Cafe Trail: Britannia & Co Berry Pulao & Caramel Custard
experiences.description: Taste iconic Bombay Parsi gastronomy inside a 100-year-old heritage establishment. Savor Iranian berry pulao and velvety caramel custard.
experiences.address: Ballard Estate, Fort, Mumbai

experiences.title: Kumbharwada Clay Potter Colony Guild Masterclass
experiences.description: Witness 1,000+ Gujarati immigrant potters handcrafting terracotta diyas, matkas, and garden planters in Mumbai's oldest ceramic commune.
experiences.address: Kumbharwada, 90 Feet Road, Dharavi, Mumbai

experiences.title: Queen's Necklace Sunset Breeze & Roasted Bhutta Walk
experiences.description: Relax on the iconic sea-facing promenade listening to crashing waves while enjoying charcoal-roasted spiced corn on the cob.
experiences.address: Marine Drive Promenade, Churchgate, Mumbai

experiences.title: Fontainhas Latin Quarter Pastel Houses & Bebinca Workshop
experiences.description: Explore narrow winding alleys of Asia's only Latin Quarter, painted in ochre and cobalt blue, followed by a 7-layer Bebinca baking demo.
experiences.address: Fontainhas, Panaji, Goa

experiences.title: Divar Island Serene Electric Bicycle River Cruise & Local Feni Tasting
experiences.description: Take a flat wooden ferry to sleepy Divar Island, cycle through paddy fields and ancient churches, and learn traditional cashew feni distilling.
experiences.address: Divar Ferry Point, Goa

experiences.title: Organic Spice Plantation Farm-to-Table Goan Lunch & Herb Tour
experiences.description: Walk amidst vanilla vines, cardamom pods, and cinnamon bark followed by a banana-leaf lunch of Goan vegetable caldin and red rice.
experiences.address: Badem Road, Assagao, North Goa

experiences.title: Butterfly Beach Hidden Kayaking & Bioluminescent Sunset Paddle
experiences.description: Glide in double kayaks past dolphin feeding bays to secluded Butterfly Cove for panoramic sunset reflections over the Arabian Sea.
experiences.address: Palolem Beach South End, Canacona, South Goa

experiences.title: Chinese Fishing Nets Mechanics & Fresh Catch Tawa Fry Session
experiences.description: Operate 14th-century cantilevered fishing nets with local fishermen and have your selected catch freshly spiced and seared with curry leaves.
experiences.address: Vasco da Gama Square, Fort Kochi

experiences.title: Jew Town Antique Spice Warehouse Aroma Walk & Ginger Drying Yards
experiences.description: Walk through 400-year-old spice trading lanes near the Paradesi Synagogue, inhaling sun-dried Malabar black pepper, star anise, and cardamom.
experiences.address: Synagogue Lane, Mattancherry, Kochi

experiences.title: Kumbalangi Integrated Village Backwater Canoe Trail & Crab Farming
experiences.description: Quiet country canoe tour through mangrove forests, coir yarn spinning by village women, and sustainable mud crab catching.
experiences.address: Kumbalangi Tourism Village, Kochi Outskirts

experiences.title: Kathakali Green Room Facial Makeup Ritual & Mudra Demo
experiences.description: Watch classical Kathakali artists apply natural mineral makeup over 2 hours, followed by a live demonstration of eyes and hand mudras.
experiences.address: Kerala Kathakali Centre, KB Jacob Road, Fort Kochi

experiences.title: Chandni Chowk 7-Stop Heritage Breakfast Trail: Daulat Ki Chaat & Jalebi
experiences.description: Wind through Dariba Kalan and Paranthe Wali Gali for winter foam cloud Daulat ki Chaat, giant saffron jalebis, and Bedmi Puri aloo.
experiences.address: Opposite Central Baptist Church, Chandni Chowk, Old Delhi

experiences.title: Hazrat Nizamuddin Dargah Evening Sufi Qawwali Circle
experiences.description: Sit in the historic 14th-century marble courtyard as traditional Qawwals sing mystical poetry of Amir Khusro under glowing brass lamps.
experiences.address: Dargah Hazrat Nizamuddin Auliya, West Nizamuddin, Delhi

experiences.title: Hauz Khas Medieval Madrasa Sunset & Indie Boutique Trail
experiences.description: Explore 13th-century Sultanate stone arches overlooking the deer park reservoir, followed by coffee at an independent rooftop book cafe.
experiences.address: Hauz Khas Village, South Delhi

experiences.title: Lodhi Art District Open-Air Street Mural & Botanical Garden Walk
experiences.description: India's first public art district featuring over 50 large-scale murals by international artists, followed by a shaded walk through Lodhi Gardens.
experiences.address: Lodhi Art District, Lodhi Colony, New Delhi

experiences.title: Subah-e-Banaras Morning Raga Flute Recital & Wooden Rowing Boat Ride
experiences.description: Experience divine dawn classical morning ragas, Surya Namaskar by sadhus, and a wooden rowing boat past historical palaces along the Ganges.
experiences.address: Assi Ghat, Shivala, Varanasi

experiences.title: Blue Lassi Shop Hand-Churned Fruit Lassi & Peda Tasting
experiences.description: Sit on clay benches in a century-old alleyway watching thick creamy curd hand-churned in earthen matkas with pomegranate and pistachio.
experiences.address: CK 12/40 Bangali Tola, Varanasi

experiences.title: Master Banarasi Silk Pit-Loom Weaving & Zari Brocade Masterclass
experiences.description: Meet 4th-generation Muslim master weavers crafting intricate gold zari motifs on hand-cranked jacquard looms in traditional living rooms.
experiences.address: Madanpura Weaver Colony, Varanasi

experiences.title: Tibetan Singing Bowl Sound Bath & Himalayan Herbal Chai
experiences.description: Deep meditation and frequency relaxation inside a cedar-scented studio with views of the cascading river, followed by freshly brewed spiced chai.
experiences.address: High Bank, Tapovan, Rishikesh

experiences.title: Ganges River Grade-III Whitewater Rafting & Cliff Jump
experiences.description: Navigate exciting Himalayan river rapids (Roller Coaster, Golf Course) with certified river rescue guides, ending with an optional 20ft jump.
experiences.address: Shivpuri Rafting Base, Rishikesh

experiences.title: The Beatles Chaurasi Kutia Ashram Graffiti & Forest Meditation Walk
experiences.description: Walk amidst stone meditation domes where the Beatles wrote the White Album in 1968, adorned with psychedelic pop murals in Rajaji Tiger Reserve.
experiences.address: Beatles Ashram, Swarg Ashram, Rishikesh

experiences.title: CTR (Shri Sagar) Crispy Benne Dosa & Filter Kaapi Heritage Breakfast
experiences.description: Savor Bengaluru's legendary golden-brown butter benne dosas served with spicy mint and coconut chutneys, finished with foamy decoction coffee.
experiences.address: 7th Cross, Margosa Road, Malleshwaram, Bengaluru

experiences.title: Indie Microbrewery Craft Beer Flight & Rooftop Botanical Tour
experiences.description: Sample 6 house-brewed beers infused with local spices, kokum, and mango inside an open-air rooftop green oasis.
experiences.address: 100 Feet Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru

experiences.title: Cubbon Park Bamboo Grove Nature Sketching & Tree Walk
experiences.description: Discover 100+ species of heritage colonial canopy trees and bamboo groves led by a local botanist, with provided charcoal sketching kits.
experiences.address: Kasturba Road, Sampangi Rama Nagar, Bengaluru

experiences.title: Kumartuli Clay Idol Sculptor Enclave & Ganges Straw Sculpting Demo
experiences.description: Walk among hundreds of traditional clay artisans shaping monumental idols of Durga using holy river silt and bamboo straw frameworks.
experiences.address: Kumartuli, Banamali Sarkar Street, North Kolkata

experiences.title: College Street Boi-Para Book Bazaar & Indian Coffee House Mutton Cutlet
experiences.description: Browse the world's largest second-hand book market with over 1.5 miles of wooden stalls, ending with adda over coffee in high-ceiling halls.
experiences.address: College Street, Central Kolkata

experiences.title: Nizam's Kathi Roll Origin Tasting & Flurys Afternoon Tea Pastry
experiences.description: Bite into the original flaky paratha Kathi roll at Nizam's where it was invented in 1932, followed by vintage rum balls at Flurys.
experiences.address: New Market / Park Street, Kolkata

experiences.title: Laitlum 'End of the World' Canyon Ridge Trek & Khasi Cloud Picnic
experiences.description: Perch atop breathtaking 3,000ft gorges overlooking misty Khasi river valleys and enjoy hot indigenous sticky rice cakes with ginger tea.
experiences.address: Laitlum Gorges, East Khasi Hills, Meghalaya

experiences.title: Khasi Indigenous Bamboo Basketry & Traditional Ja-Dai Culinary Trail
experiences.description: Learn intricate cane weaving techniques from matriarchal Khasi artisans, followed by traditional steamed pork or bamboo shoot platters.
experiences.address: Lewduh Bara Bazar, Shillong
